_comment: MAGMA CREAM. Swarf comes off the tool soaked in cutting fluid, which is why real swarf
recycling starts by separating the metal from the oil - the oil is recovered and the chips
are dried before they can be melted. Cook that oil fraction and what is left is a hot
Separating, because the input genuinely IS two things and this is the machine that divides a
mixed feed. The byproduct is the other half: the chips themselves, which are scrap metal.
One material answering to two verbs is not new here - slag already separates, pulverizes AND
vitrifies into three different things. What makes it honest in both cases is that the verbs
are doing different work on the same material rather than being two names for one recipe.
It also gives magma cream its only route: vanilla makes it from blaze powder and a slime
ball, and this world has no slime at all.
COUNT IS 1, and must be (owner, 2026-08-19): a GUI-less machine cannot take N > 1 inputs to
make an output. This was 4. A machine with no GUI and no Container has nothing to open and
nothing to take back out, so a remainder the recipe cannot use is invisible and unrecoverable -
and a remainder is the NORMAL state, because the pull streams hand their scrap out one item at
Ticks and energy are unchanged on purpose. An operation already made one output, so the cost
per output in time and power is the same as before; the only thing that moves is the material
ratio, and that is #36's, whose dial is the drop weight.
